microtheory.name: geology
microtheory.definition: Geology — Earth's composition, structure, processes, history. Mineralogy, petrology, structural geology, stratigraphy, paleontology, plate tectonics, geochemistry, geophysics, geomorphology. Hutton, Lyell, Wegener, Holmes, Vine + Matthews. Earth as 4.54 billion-year dynamic system. Substrate analogue: deep-time processes shaping the physical substrate biology and humans operate on.

concepts.name: earth_structure
concepts.definition: Crust (5-70 km) + mantle (to 2900 km) + outer core (liquid Fe) + inner core (solid Fe). Inferred from seismic waves.

concepts.name: lithosphere
concepts.definition: Rigid outer shell (crust + uppermost mantle). Divided into tectonic plates ~100 km thick.

concepts.name: asthenosphere
concepts.definition: Plastic upper mantle below lithosphere. Convection cells drive plate motion.

concepts.name: moho_discontinuity
concepts.definition: Boundary between crust + mantle. Seismic velocity jump. Mohorovičić 1909.

concepts.name: plate_tectonics
concepts.definition: Wegener (continental drift) + Holmes + Vine-Matthews (seafloor spreading) + Hess synthesis. Lithosphere divided into ~20 plates moving over asthenosphere. Unifying theory ~1960s.

concepts.name: continental_drift
concepts.definition: Wegener 1912. Continents move. Ridiculed initially; mechanism (mantle convection + seafloor spreading) found later.

concepts.name: seafloor_spreading
concepts.definition: Hess 1962. New crust formed at mid-ocean ridges; pushes plates apart. Confirmed by magnetic stripe symmetry.

concepts.name: subduction_zone
concepts.definition: Convergent plate boundary where denser plate dives under. Creates trenches + arcs + earthquakes + volcanoes.

concepts.name: transform_fault
concepts.definition: Plates slide past horizontally. San Andreas. Earthquakes characteristic.

concepts.name: mid_ocean_ridge
concepts.definition: Divergent boundary. Volcanic ridge where new oceanic crust forms.

concepts.name: hotspot_volcanic
concepts.definition: Mantle plume creating chain as plate moves over. Hawaii, Yellowstone.

concepts.name: mineral
concepts.definition: Naturally occurring inorganic solid with definite chemical composition + crystal structure. ~5500 known.

concepts.name: crystal_structure
concepts.definition: Atomic arrangement. Seven crystal systems. Determines properties.

concepts.name: mohs_hardness
concepts.definition: Mohs 1812. Scratch resistance scale 1-10. Talc 1, diamond 10. Field test for minerals.

concepts.name: silicate
concepts.definition: SiO4 tetrahedra. ~90% of Earth's crust. Olivine, pyroxene, amphibole, mica, feldspar, quartz.

concepts.name: rock_cycle
concepts.definition: Igneous → sedimentary → metamorphic interconversion via melting, weathering, heat/pressure. Substrate analogue: substrate's material transformation cycle.

concepts.name: igneous_rock
concepts.definition: Solidified from magma/lava. Intrusive (granite) vs extrusive (basalt). Composition + cooling rate determine.

concepts.name: sedimentary_rock
concepts.definition: Lithified sediment. Clastic (sandstone), chemical (limestone), organic (coal). Hosts most fossils.

concepts.name: metamorphic_rock
concepts.definition: Pre-existing rock altered by heat + pressure + fluids without melting. Marble (from limestone), slate (from shale), gneiss.

concepts.name: stratigraphy
concepts.definition: Study of rock layers + time relationships. Principle of superposition (Steno). Index fossils for correlation.

concepts.name: geologic_time_scale
concepts.definition: Eons → Eras → Periods → Epochs. Hadean, Archean, Proterozoic, Phanerozoic. Calibrated by radiometric dating + biostratigraphy.

concepts.name: radiometric_dating
concepts.definition: Decay of unstable isotopes. U-Pb, K-Ar, C-14. Most precise: U-Pb on zircon. Earth age 4.54 Gy.

concepts.name: uniformitarianism
concepts.definition: Hutton + Lyell. Present processes explain past. Slow gradual change vs catastrophism. Modern view: both.

concepts.name: deep_time
concepts.definition: Hutton 1788 'no vestige of beginning, no prospect of end'. Geological timescales radically beyond human experience.

concepts.name: fossil
concepts.definition: Preserved remains/traces of past organism. Body fossils, trace fossils, molds, casts. Window into evolutionary history.

concepts.name: extinction_event
concepts.definition: Mass die-off. Five major: Ordovician, Devonian, Permian-Triassic (96% species), Triassic-Jurassic, Cretaceous-Paleogene (dinosaurs).

concepts.name: kt_extinction
concepts.definition: K-Pg boundary. Asteroid impact (Chicxulub) 66 Mya + Deccan vulcanism. Dinosaurs out; mammals rise.

concepts.name: earthquake
concepts.definition: Sudden release of accumulated tectonic stress. Hypocenter, epicenter, magnitude (moment magnitude), intensity (Modified Mercalli).

concepts.name: volcano
concepts.definition: Magma + gas + ash erupting at surface. Shield, stratovolcano, caldera. Ring of Fire concentrated.

concepts.name: tsunami
concepts.definition: Long-wavelength ocean waves from undersea earthquake/landslide/volcanic activity. 2004 Indian Ocean, 2011 Tōhoku.

concepts.name: erosion
concepts.definition: Wear + transport by water, wind, ice, gravity. Shapes landscapes over millions of years.

concepts.name: glaciation
concepts.definition: Ice ages. Quaternary cycles ~100 Ky. Shaped current topography (Great Lakes, fjords).

concepts.name: weathering
concepts.definition: In-place breakdown. Physical (frost, thermal) + chemical (oxidation, hydrolysis, carbonation).

concepts.name: river_geomorphology
concepts.definition: Rivers carve valleys. Erosion + deposition shape floodplains, deltas, meanders.

concepts.name: hydrosphere
concepts.definition: Earth's water. Oceans 97%, ice 2%, groundwater ~1%, lakes/rivers/atmosphere <0.01%.

concepts.name: atmosphere
concepts.definition: Gas envelope. N2 78%, O2 21%, Ar 0.9%, CO2 0.04%. Troposphere → stratosphere → mesosphere → thermosphere.

concepts.name: geochemistry
concepts.definition: Chemistry of Earth materials. Element distributions, isotope ratios trace processes.

rules.name: plate_tectonics_explains_global_geology
rules.head: Jabberwock considers geological phenomena
rules.body: plate tectonics provides unifying explanation: earthquakes, volcanoes, mountain belts, ocean basins, continental positions, biogeography all derive from plate motion. Wegener-Hess-Vine-Matthews synthesis.

rules.name: uniformitarianism_with_punctuation
rules.head: Jabberwock interprets past geological processes
rules.body: Hutton + Lyell: present is key to past. Modern correction: gradual processes + occasional catastrophes (asteroid impacts, mega-eruptions) both shape record.

rules.name: rock_cycle_links_lithology
rules.head: Jabberwock classifies a rock
rules.body: every rock has place in cycle: was once igneous → weathered → sedimentary → buried → metamorphic → melted → igneous again. Cycle continuous.

rules.name: radiometric_dating_anchors_geological_time
rules.head: Jabberwock dates a geological event
rules.body: decay of unstable isotopes (U-Pb, K-Ar, C-14) provides absolute ages. Calibrates entire geological time scale. Earth age 4.54 Gy.

rules.name: deep_time_dwarfs_human_experience
rules.head: Jabberwock considers geological timescales
rules.body: millions to billions of years are required to develop intuition for. Hutton's 'no vestige of beginning'. Substrate's temporal-scale humbling.
